title: Steel column, flexural buckling (EN 1993-1-1)
description: Flexural buckling resistance of a steel column about one axis, EN 1993-1-1 6.3.1: Ncr = π²EI/Lcr², relative slenderness λ̄, reduction factor χ from the imperfection factor α of the buckling curve (a0 0.13, a 0.21, b 0.34, c 0.49, d 0.76), Nb,Rd = χ·A·fy/γM1. Example: HEB 200 about z (curve c), 4 m, S355.
author: AlirezaKORD
